description: The Settings dialog's Telemetry page (Baude's, Record's and the phone's; on the phone the fourth page of Settings, switched to by the bar at its foot): for the host picked beside New session, whether it collects telemetry, then what it keeps, as it answers telemetry_read: its turns' tokens by day over a year, the most used model and effort and each model's turns, its machine now, its chats' latest activity, and line profiling of its processes.
opens: Settings… → Telemetry (the dialog's page switcher; the phone's: the bar at Settings' foot)

parts.name: Host
parts.shows: Row "Host" with the picked host's name after it (dim). On the phone, This phone's own host when it's the one picked.

parts.name: Collect Telemetry
parts.shows: A switch row "Collect Telemetry", on while the host keeps chat events and samples its machine (the host's own state, kept in its state folder; on unless switched off). The host keeps events 400 days (the tokens' grid is a year), samples 7 days and profiles 30 days.

actions.does: Switches the host's telemetry on or off at once (telemetry_set on); the apps on its machine follow it through its Info's telemetry and tell it nothing while it's off

decisions.said: Once a minute is completely bonkers and quite useless
decisions.rule: Every app tells its machine's host each event as it happens, with its own time to the millisecond; nothing is batched by the minute
Telemetry is switched on and off at run time, from this row on every app and by telemetry_set from any member of the mesh

parts.name: Tokens by Day
parts.shows: Heading "Tokens by Day", then a boxed list: a grid of a year of days like GitHub's contributions (a square a day, a column a week, Sunday at the top, today's the last), each square as dark as its day's share of the busiest day's tokens in the accent colour, a day without turns faint; its tooltip (desktop) the day and its tokens. Under it a row "Most Used" with the model and effort with the most turns ("Opus 4.7 · High effort").

decisions.said: Telemetry should have a git-like grid of tokens passed through Baude, the models used, and the most used model-effort combination (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows the host's tokens by day over the last year as a contributions grid, the most used model and effort, and each model's turns and tokens, added up by the host (telemetry_read's usage) from the turns its sessions ran, each turn once

parts.name: Models
parts.shows: Heading "Models", a row each model that ran a turn in the year, the most turns first: its name, and "600 Turns · 280.8M" after it ("1 Turn" for one), dim.

parts.name: Machine
parts.shows: Heading "Machine": rows of the host's latest sample, asked again every 5 seconds while the page is shown: Load (1, 5 and 15 minutes; not on a phone), Memory (in use of the total, "11.0 GB of 16.0 GB"), Available ("5.0 GB"), Swap (in use of the total, "1.2 GB of 3.0 GB"), Memory Pressure (the level the system gives, "Normal", "Warning" or "Critical", on macOS and a phone; on Linux the share of the last 10 seconds some task stalled on memory, "1.3% Stalled"), each only where the host could tell it, then the host process, Baude and Record (the phone's app on a phone) each with its CPU and memory ("6.2% · 613 MB"). While telemetry is off, one dim row "Telemetry is off" in its place.

decisions.rule: Every host samples its machine's load and memory and its own and each app's CPU and memory every 5 seconds while telemetry is on, with no new dependency, and keeps them timestamped for a month

decisions.said: In telemetry we probably want to record both memory and swap (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every host samples its memory in use and available, its swap in use of its total, and the memory pressure its system gives (macOS's pressure level, Linux's pressure stall share, a phone's low memory), with no new dependency, and every app shows them under Machine

parts.name: Chat Activity
parts.shows: Heading "Chat Activity", the latest 12 events of the last day, the latest first: the chat's title (its id's start where the app doesn't know it), then what happened and when, dim: "Chat Opened", "Chat in Front", "Chat Left", "Turn Sent", "Turn Ended in 2m 11s", "23:48:29". A turn's end the host and an app both saw is shown once. None: one dim row "Nothing recorded".

decisions.said: Sreen time is a pretty useless metric, how is that going to help me make the app better (in isolation)
decisions.rule: No app counts time on screen per place or menu uses; what's kept is a log of events, each with its own time, that can be put together with the host's samples and profiles

decisions.said: Store chat activity yes with timestamps
decisions.rule: Every app keeps each chat opened, chat in front, chat left, turn sent and turn ended (with how long it took, its model, effort and tokens) by the chat's host id and session id; the chat's host keeps each of its turns' ends too. A chat's size, messages and images are never kept: chat_size works them out from its transcript when they're asked for

parts.name: Line Profiling
parts.shows: A boxed list: a switch row "Line Profiling" (on while the process picked profiles something; off and greyed out while telemetry is off), "Process" with a picker (Host Process, Baude, Record), "Functions" (an entry: dotted names of functions and modules, comma-separated), and, where a name isn't found, its error in one dim row. Then "Top Lines": the picked process's 10 lines that took longest in the last hour (read again every 30 seconds while a process profiles, as its profiles are taken), the file's name and line number and the line's code in monospace, and "120 Hits · 0.912s" after it (the phone: its time alone). Without line_profiler on that host: one row, line_profiler and the command that installs it with Copy, as Dependencies has it (pip of the host's own Python, --user, and --break-system-packages only where that Python is externally managed). Not on the phone's own host (no Python there).

actions.does: The process picked profiles those functions from now (telemetry_set app, functions)
Off: it profiles nothing (what it timed is kept); on: it profiles what the entry names

decisions.rule: line_profiler is an optional dependency (schema/deps/line_profiler.json); the host process, Baude and Record each profile the functions and modules the host is told for them, switched at run time, saving what they timed every 30 seconds with its times; with nothing named, nothing of it runs

states: off: Collect Telemetry off, "Telemetry is off" in the machine's place
empty: no turns in the year: the grid all faint, no Most Used or Models; no events: "Nothing recorded"
error: the host's error in one dim row
no line_profiler: its install row in Line Profiling's place

removed.name: Period picker, Screen Time in <app> and Used in <app> lists
removed.why: The owner: "Sreen time is a pretty useless metric, how is that going to help me make the app better (in isolation)" and "Once a minute is completely bonkers and quite useless"
